_comment: SPOILER İÇERİR. Save Inventory codes → display names, for rule work and the diagnostics (the patch locres has no names for these codes). Key: the code as it appears in Inventory.MainWeaponInfos / ShaChiWeaponInfo / AccessoryInfos / InventoryInfos (lib/state.js items). en: official English name; tr: Turkish name from the Turkish patch (title-cased), or null when not certain (the UI then shows English); guess: true = the code ↔ item mapping is not verified. Mappings verified by acquisition time on a real save (2026-11-06). Not bundled into the web build (the page only shows codes).

LuanYing.note: Main weapon. The sword on the pier after Mu Xiaokui (Village of Lu, before the lift); rule lu-elevator-sword.

YuuBlade.note: Main weapon, Mu Xiaokui's reward (acquired just before LuanYing). Fiend Saws is likely (the five-ribbon reward) but not verified.

KuYeSiZhuChuan.note: Sha-chi weapon (Phantom Edge), from Bi Hai.

CaoOuSiXian.note: Sha-chi weapon (Phantom Edge) acquired after the Dusk fight; the name is a guess.

AC_ResistRanged.note: Accessory, the wounded thief's reward for the Thief's Manual; rule lu-wounded-thief-manual (doneWhen).

AC_SummonDuration.note: Accessory acquired at 01:46 on the mapping save; the name is a guess.
